svg.title: How speculative decoding writes and overwrites KV slots
svg.desc: Request A has 16 computed tokens and two draft tokens. In step N the target model computes A16, d17 and d18 at positions 16 to 18, which write slots 192 to 194 in block 12, and two lookahead slots are reserved after them. d17 is accepted and d18 is rejected, so num_computed_tokens becomes 18 and slot 194 holds stale KV. In step N+1 the request continues from position 18 with the token t18 from the target model and two new drafts. The new KV overwrites slot 194, and no block is freed.

g.text: STEP N · THE TARGET MODEL VERIFIES TWO DRAFTS
A: NUM_COMPUTED_TOKENS 16 · SPEC_TOKEN_IDS [D17, D18] · 3 TOKENS SCHEDULED
Lookahead slot reserved for a drafter with its own KV cache, such as EAGLE (K = 2)
